_documentation.datasetId: Must identify an independently labelled dataset registered outside this repository. No labelled security dataset is fabricated or shipped here.
_documentation.groups: fitGroups and validationGroups are repository/project identifiers. They must be disjoint; overlap is rejected at config load time.
_documentation.acceptance: Explicit validation gates for emitting a calibrated probability. Failing any gate yields a rejected artifact that remains auditable but cannot be used.
_documentation.status: Replace all REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders with real dataset and group identifiers before running an experiment.
